'''Yunyan'' is an NPc that appears in [[Lollo Warehouse]], [[Whining Aix's Mire]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yunyan:''' If you have an express to send, please fill out the form according to the template.
:{{DIcon}} Template?
:'''Yunyan:''' The template is on the notice board over there. You can check it out.
:'''Yunyan:''' Please pay special attention to the item type, as well as the expected delivery date.
:{{DIcon}} Quite strict rules for a delivery service.
:'''Yunyan:''' We follow these strict rules just to ensure a smooth delivery.
:'''Yunyan:''' Especially when your package has to travel through a timid, foggy swamp here in Whining Aix's Mire.
:'''Yunyan:''' Most of the packages are bound for Frosting Harbor, and taking the Heron Wetland is the only shortcut.
:'''Yunyan:''' To describe the dense fog... packages would be soaked by the fog in the past.
:'''Yunyan:''' Quite strict rules for a delivery service.
:'''Yunyan:''' Thankfully, [[Mumian]], my colleague, invented a type of dehumidifier. When paired with our special delivery boxes, we can ensure the package stays dry for three days.
:'''Yunyan:''' But even with this extra insurance, one can never be too careful when you're traveling through Whining Aix's Mire.
{{Dialogue End}}
